cues.headline: GOAL! Ulric Corvel!
cues.body: Kingsford Rovers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 0–1 Kingsford Rovers.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.2 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 5.0 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: Emil Calloway is everywhere
cues.body: Emil Calloway has completed 40 passes already.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over: they've had the ball 76% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Just what Elmstead Wanderers need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 36%, Kingsford Rovers 64%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers let one slip
cues.body: That was a big one for Emil Calloway: 79% of chances like it end up in the net.

cues.headline: Emil Calloway scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 1–1 Kingsford Rovers. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: It's in! Emil Calloway!
cues.body: Emil Calloway finds the net for Elmstead Wanderers: Elmstead Wanderers 2–1 Kingsford Rovers. It came 6 seconds after Elmstead Wanderers won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are on top: recovering the ball 3 times in the final third, winning the ball back in the opposition half 4 times and leaving Kingsford Rovers just 1.2 passes per defensive action in the last 5 minutes. Elmstead Wanderers are already ahead, and still pushing.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 2–1 Kingsford Rovers
recap.summary: A deserved win for Elmstead Wanderers.
